title: Robert W. Scrivner Research Professor of Economics and Social Policy
affiliation: Robert W. Scrivner Research Professor of Economics and Social Policy
bio: George J. Borjas is the Robert W. Scrivner Professor of Economics and Social Policy. He received his PhD in economics from Columbia. His teaching and research interests focus on the impact of government regulations on labor markets, with an emphasis on the economic impact of immigration. He is the author of Wage Policy in the Federal Bureaucracy; Friends or Strangers: The Impact of Immigrants on the U.S.
